description: This line plot illustrates the average correct gate rate across different input types as a function of an unspecified x-axis variable ranging from 0 to 30, with the y-axis representing the average correct gate rate on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0. The x-axis is labeled “Embedding Layer” but lacks specific tick labels beyond the numerical range. The y-axis is labeled “Average Correct Gate Rate.” Four distinct lines are plotted, each with a corresponding shaded confidence interval: a solid blue line labeled “Character Attention input,” a dashed blue line labeled “Character MLP input,” a solid red line labeled “Wiki Attention input,” and a dashed red line labeled “Wiki MLP input.” The solid blue line begins near 0.1 at x=0, rises sharply to approximately 0.82 by x=5, then declines to around 0.25 by x=12 before increasing again to about 0.7 by x=25 and ending near 0.72 at x=30. The dashed blue line starts near 0.1 at x=0, peaks above 0.9 at x=5, dips to around 0.55 by x=12, and then fluctuates between approximately 0.7 and 0.9 through x=30. The solid red line starts at 0.2 at x=0, rises to approximately 0.82 at x=5, then falls to about 0.38 by x=12 before rising again to roughly 0.65 by x=25 and ending near 0.7 at x=30. The dashed red line begins near 0.2 at x=0, peaks above 0.9 at x=5, dips to around 0.6 by x=12, and then fluctuates between approximately 0.55 and 0.85 through x=30.
